name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2457: He reported a black console twice while its heartbeat read perfectly healthy: n advancing, 11,707 elements, zero blank strikes. The blank detector counts DOM elements and his blank has a full DOM. Timers and animation frames are throttled by different machinery, so a page that stops painting keeps every timer-driven signal green, and the tooltips he could still see on hover were the clue rather than a contradiction. The page now reports a frame counter and the server publishes a three-valued paint witness that reports and never acts. Also: every fleet row is measured against one denominator now, the chronicle routes and the roster routes are on the heart, and the card no longer paints its bars across its own words.
